summary: Alone in the Dark entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Alone in the Dark
entries.definitive_edition: Original PC release through current legal package/DOSBox with settings documented

emulation.notes: Use DOSBox/current package for primary unless original hardware is available.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original DOS/PC build with exact audio/input/version state documented

primary.version: Original Alone in the Dark 1 through current PC package or DOSBox
primary.why: The 1992 game is the survival-horror baseline and is distinct from the 2008 reboot and 2024 reimagining. The current PC package/DOSBox route is practical, but original DOS controls, sound, and version state matter.
primary.how_to_play: Use the original PC release through a current legal package or DOSBox. Record version/source, DOSBox settings, input, audio device, language, difficulty/save state, and whether 3DO/iOS or later reboots were excluded.

entries.remaster_caveats: Do not merge with Alone in the Dark (2008) or Alone in the Dark (2024).
